title: Knowledge check: Route Handlers and Handler Chains

questions.prompt: In Route Handlers and Handler Chains, which statement best describes Single route handlers?
options: Move all backend decisions into the browser and trust the submitted values.
Return the same success response for every request regardless of outcome.
Treat the HTTP method and path as an API contract. Use the current Express 5 path syntax, validate captured values, and test both matching and non-matching requests.

Connect this syllabus point to Route Handlers and Handler Chains: state the expected behavior, identify a realistic edge case, and choose a test or observation that proves the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.

questions.explanation: Treat the HTTP method and path as an API contract. Use the current Express 5 path syntax, validate captured values, and test both matching and non-matching requests.

questions.prompt: A change related to Route Handlers and Handler Chains appears to work for one normal request. What is the strongest next verification step?
